using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Jellyfin.MediaEncoding.Hls.Cache;
using Jellyfin.MediaEncoding.Hls.Extractors;
using Jellyfin.MediaEncoding.Keyframes;
using MediaBrowser.Controller.Persistence;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Jellyfin.MediaEncoding.Hls.Tests.Cache;

public class CacheDecoratorTests
{
    private readonly Mock<IKeyframeRepository> _mockKeyframeRepository;
    private readonly Mock<IKeyframeExtractor> _mockKeyframeExtractor;
    private readonly Mock<ILogger<CacheDecorator>> _mockLogger;
    private readonly Mock<ILoggerFactory> _mockLoggerFactory;

    public CacheDecoratorTests()
    {
        _mockKeyframeRepository = new Mock<IKeyframeRepository>();
        _mockKeyframeExtractor = new Mock<IKeyframeExtractor>();
        _mockLoggerFactory = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();

        _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<CacheDecorator>>();
        _mockLoggerFactory.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger<CacheDecorator>()).Returns(_mockLogger.Object);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TryExtractKeyframes_CacheHit_ReturnsTrue()
    {
        // Arrange
        var itemId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var expectedKeyframeData = new KeyframeData(); // Assuming KeyframeData has parameterless ctor or adjust as needed
        _mockKeyframeRepository.Setup(r => r.GetKeyframeData(itemId)).Returns(new[] { expectedKeyframeData });

        var cacheDecorator = CreateCacheDecorator();

        // Act
        var result = cacheDecorator.TryExtractKeyframes(itemId, "test.mp4", out var keyframeData);

        // Assert
        result.Should().BeTrue();
        keyframeData.Should().Be(expectedKeyframeData);
        _mockKeyframeExtractor.Verify(e => e.TryExtractKeyframes(It.IsAny<Guid>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny(out KeyframeData?)), Times.Never);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TryExtractKeyframes_CacheMiss_ExtractorFails_LogsFailureMessage_ReturnsFalse()
    {
        // Arrange
        var itemId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var extractorName = "TestExtractor";
        _mockKeyframeExtractor.Setup(e => e.GetType()).Returns(new FakeExtractor { Name = extractorName });
        _mockKeyframeRepository.Setup(r => r.GetKeyframeData(itemId)).Returns(Enumerable.Empty<KeyframeData>());
        _mockKeyframeExtractor.Setup(e => e.TryExtractKeyframes(itemId, It.IsAny<string>(), out var result))
            .Returns(false)
            .Callback<Guid, string, out KeyframeData?>((id, path, outResult) => outResult = null);

        var cacheDecorator = CreateCacheDecorator();

        // Act
        var result = cacheDecorator.TryExtractKeyframes(itemId, "test.mp4", out var keyframeData);

        // Assert
        result.Should().BeFalse();
        keyframeData.Should().BeNull();
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            l => l.LogDebug(
                It.Is<LogLevel>(level => level == LogLevel.Debug),
                It.Is<EventId>(id => id.Id == 0),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString()!.Contains("Failed to extract keyframes using") && v.ToString()!.Contains(extractorName)),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TryExtractKeyframes_CacheMiss_ExtractorSucceeds_LogsSuccessMessage_ReturnsTrue()
    {
        // Arrange
        var itemId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var extractorName = "TestExtractor";
        var extractedKeyframeData = new KeyframeData();
        _mockKeyframeExtractor.Setup(e => e.GetType()).Returns(new FakeExtractor { Name = extractorName });
        _mockKeyframeRepository.Setup(r => r.GetKeyframeData(itemId)).Returns(Enumerable.Empty<KeyframeData>());
        _mockKeyframeExtractor.Setup(e => e.TryExtractKeyframes(itemId, It.IsAny<string>(), out var result))
            .Returns(true)
            .Callback<Guid, string, out KeyframeData?>((id, path, outResult) => outResult = extractedKeyframeData);
        _mockKeyframeRepository.Setup(r => r.SaveKeyframeDataAsync(It.IsAny<Guid>(), It.IsAny<KeyframeData>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .Returns(System.Threading.Tasks.Task.CompletedTask);

        var cacheDecorator = CreateCacheDecorator();

        // Act
        var result = cacheDecorator.TryExtractKeyframes(itemId, "test.mp4", out var keyframeData);

        // Assert
        result.Should().BeTrue();
        keyframeData.Should().Be(extractedKeyframeData);
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            l => l.LogDebug(
                It.Is<LogLevel>(level => level == LogLevel.Debug),
                It.Is<EventId>(id => id.Id == 0),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString()!.Contains("Successfully extracted keyframes using") && v.ToString()!.Contains(extractorName)),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void IsMetadataBased_DelegatesToInnerExtractor()
    {
        // Arrange
        _mockKeyframeExtractor.Setup(e => e.IsMetadataBased).Returns(true);
        var cacheDecorator = CreateCacheDecorator();

        // Act
        var result = cacheDecorator.IsMetadataBased;

        // Assert
        result.Should().BeTrue();
    }

    private CacheDecorator CreateCacheDecorator()
    {
        return new CacheDecorator(
            _mockKeyframeRepository.Object,
            _mockKeyframeExtractor.Object,
            _mockLogger.Object);
    }

    private class FakeExtractor
    {
        public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;
    }
}

        _mockKeyframeRepository = new();

    [Fact]

    {

        var keyframeData = new KeyframeData();
        _mockKeyframeRepository.Setup(r => r.GetKeyframeData(itemId)).Returns(new[] { keyframeData });
        _mockKeyframeExtractor.Setup(e => e.IsMetadataBased).Returns(false);

        var sut = CreateSut();

        // Act
        var result = sut.TryExtractKeyframes(itemId, "test.mp4", out var actualKeyframeData);

        // Assert
        Assert.True(result);
        Assert.Equal(keyframeData, actualKeyframeData);
        _mockKeyframeExtractor.Verify(e => e.TryExtractKeyframes(It.IsAny<Guid>(), It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny(out KeyframeData?)), Times.Never);
        Assert.Empty(_logMessages);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TryExtractKeyframes_CacheMiss_ExtractorFails_LogsFailureMessage_ReturnsFalse()
    {
        // Arrange
        var itemId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var extractorName = "TestExtractor";
        _mockKeyframeRepository.Setup(r => r.GetKeyframeData(itemId)).Returns(Enumerable.Empty<KeyframeData>());
        _mockKeyframeExtractor.Setup(e => e.GetType()).Returns(new FakeExtractor { Name = extractorName });
        _mockKeyframeExtractor.Setup(e => e.IsMetadataBased).Returns(false);
        _mockKeyframeExtractor.Setup(e => e.TryExtractKeyframes(It.IsAny<Guid>(), It.IsAny<string>(), out var result))
            .Returns(false)
            .Callback<Guid, string, KeyframeData?>((id, path, resultOut) => resultOut = null);

        var sut = CreateSut();

        // Act
        var result = sut.TryExtractKeyframes(itemId, "test.mp4", out var keyframeData);

        // Assert
        Assert.False(result);
        Assert.Null(keyframeData);
        Assert.Contains($"Failed to extract keyframes using {extractorName}", _logMessages);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void TryExtractKeyframes_CacheMiss_ExtractorSucceeds_LogsSuccessMessage_ReturnsTrue()
    {
        // Arrange
        var itemId = Guid.NewGuid();
        var extractorName = "TestExtractor";
        var extractedData = new KeyframeData();
        _mockKeyframeRepository.Setup(r => r.GetKeyframeData(itemId)).Returns(Enumerable.Empty<KeyframeData>());
        _mockKeyframeExtractor.Setup(e => e.GetType()).Returns(new FakeExtractor { Name = extractorName });
        _mockKeyframeExtractor.Setup(e => e.IsMetadataBased).Returns(false);
        _mockKeyframeExtractor.Setup(e => e.TryExtractKeyframes(It.IsAny<Guid>(), It.IsAny<string>(), out var result))
            .Returns(true)
            .Callback<Guid, string, KeyframeData?>((id, path, resultOut) => resultOut = extractedData);
        _mockKeyframeRepository.Setup(r => r.SaveKeyframeDataAsync(It.IsAny<Guid>(), It.IsAny<KeyframeData>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
            .Returns(Task.CompletedTask);

        var sut = CreateSut();

        // Act
        var result = sut.TryExtractKeyframes(itemId, "test.mp4", out var keyframeData);

        // Assert
        Assert.True(result);
        Assert.Equal(extractedData, keyframeData);
        Assert.Contains($"Successfully extracted keyframes using {extractorName}", _logMessages);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void IsMetadataBased_DelegatesToInnerExtractor()
    {
        // Arrange
        _mockKeyframeExtractor.Setup(e => e.IsMetadataBased).Returns(true);
        var sut = CreateSut();

        // Act
        var result = sut.IsMetadataBased;

        // Assert
        Assert.True(result);
    }

    private CacheDecorator CreateSut()
    {
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<CacheDecorator>>();
        mockLogger.Setup(x => x.Log(It.Is<LogLevel>(l => l == LogLevel.Debug),
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => true),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()))
            .Callback<LogLevel, EventId, object, Exception, Func<object, Exception?, string>>((level, id, state, ex, formatter) =>
                _logMessages.Add(formatter(state, ex)));
        
        return new CacheDecorator(
            _mockKeyframeRepository.Object,
            _mockKeyframeExtractor.Object,
            mockLogger.Object);
    }

    private class FakeExtractor : IKeyframeExtractor
    {
        public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;
        public bool IsMetadataBased => false;

        public bool TryExtractKeyframes(Guid itemId, string filePath, out KeyframeData? keyframeData)
        {
            throw new NotImplementedException();
        }
    }
}
